data.one_liner: An animated version of FractionallySizedBox that gradually changes values over time.
data.what_it_does: Provides an AnimatedFractionallySizedBox widget that automatically animates between old and new size factor properties when they change. It uses a provided duration and curve, behaving similarly to a standard FractionallySizedBox but with implicit animations.
use_when: You need to implicitly animate the widthFactor or heightFactor of a FractionallySizedBox.
You want a drop-in animated alternative to FractionallySizedBox without managing AnimationControllers manually.
avoid_when: You need to animate the child and its descendants directly.
You require fine-grained imperative control over the animation lifecycle.
strengths: Easy to use as a drop-in replacement for FractionallySizedBox.
Automatically handles implicit animations between property changes.
weaknesses: Does not animate the child widget or its descendants.
Limited to animating specific size factor properties.
data.minimal_example:
AnimatedFractionallySizedBox(
    widthFactor: widthFactor,
    heightFactor: heightFactor,
    alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
    child: ...
)
